-- Add Concrete Pump and Concrete Buggy as concrete options
INSERT INTO concrete_options (slug, name, description, costPerUnit, marginPct, pricePerUnit, unit, sortOrder, isActive)
VALUES 
  ('concrete-pump', 'Concrete Pump', 'Pump truck for delivering concrete to hard-to-reach areas', '769.23', '23.08', '1000.00', 'each', 90, 1),
  ('concrete-buggy', 'Concrete Buggy', 'Motorized buggy for transporting concrete on site', '269.23', '23.08', '350.00', 'each', 91, 1)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
  name = VALUES(name),
  description = VALUES(description),
  costPerUnit = VALUES(costPerUnit),
  marginPct = VALUES(marginPct),
  pricePerUnit = VALUES(pricePerUnit),
  unit = VALUES(unit);

-- Mark concrete removal demolition option as hasSeparateSqft (if it exists)
UPDATE demolition_options 
SET hasSeparateSqft = 1 
WHERE slug LIKE '%concrete%' OR name LIKE '%Concrete%';
